description: Wealthfolio community chart values. Credentials are external references only.

fullnameOverride.description: Explicit stable resource name; changes can select a new PVC.

image.description: Official upstream image by default, pinned to an immutable multiarchitecture digest.

repository.description: Container image repository; defaults to the official upstream image.

tag.description: Explicit application version matching the selected digest.

digest.description: Immutable image digest. Supply a matching digest when changing the image.

auth.description: Existing authentication Secret and session policy.

existingSecret.description: Required existing namespaced Secret; chart never reads or creates it.

tokenTtlMinutes.description: Session lifetime; supported practical bound is one year.

cookieSecure.description: Secure cookie policy; HTTPS ingress should use true.

listenAddress.description: Pod listener wildcard: IPv4 by default, or IPv6. Container port remains 8088.

corsAllowOrigins.description: Exact browser origins without wildcard, credentials or path.

encryption.description: Database encryption policy; no automatic conversion.

required.description: Require encrypted databases; false creates plaintext databases.

persistence.description: Whole /data storage; existingClaim ignores creation settings.

existingClaim.description: Existing namespace claim, or empty to create a retained claim.

size.description: Positive new-claim capacity; shrinking is unsupported.

storageClass.description: Null omits class, empty explicitly selects no class, named uses existing class.

accessModes.description: Exactly one filesystem access mode; RWOP requires CSI support.

annotations.description: Extra PVC annotations; Helm ownership/keep keys are reserved.

service.description: Service; public exposure requires explicit choice.

port.description: Service port; container target stays named http/8088.

nodePort.description: Only NodePort Services; must be inside the target cluster configured node-port range.

ingress.description: Optional standard root-path Ingress; no controller is installed.

className.description: Existing controller class or empty for its default.

items.description: Ingress DNS host, no wildcard or URL.

secretName.description: Optional namespace TLS Secret; omit to use the ingress controller certificate.

hosts.description: Hosts must also occur in ingress.hosts.

mcp.description: Optional in-process MCP endpoint; PATs stay outside Helm.

allowedHosts.description: Explicit Host-header allowlist required when enabled; no wildcard.

items.description: Hostname, IPv4 or bracketed IPv6, with optional port; without port permits any port.

resources.description: Initial recommendations; adjust using measured workload.

limits.description: Resource caps; no CPU cap by default.

memory.description: Positive memory limit; includes memory-backed tmp.

podSecurityContext.description: Supported numeric runtime identity and pod security.

probes.description: Unauthenticated shallow health checks; not integrity tests.

startup.description: Startup healthz; default budget approximately five minutes.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Shutdown grace; upstream does not promise request draining.

commonLabels.description: Additional labels; generated Kubernetes/Helm labels are reserved.

podLabels.description: Additional pod labels; selectors and generated labels are reserved.

podAnnotations.description: Additional nonsecret pod annotations; ownership keys reserved.

extraEnv.description: Only RUST_LOG literal or METAL_PRICE_API_KEY Secret reference.

tests.description: Unauthenticated Helm health test; no credential/PVC mount.

tag.description: Explicit reviewed tag; changing it requires clearing or reviewing digest.

digest.description: Reviewed SHA256 digest, or empty for tag-only selection.

title: Wealthfolio chart values
